headline: US Insurers Rally as Stocks Shift from AI Loser to Safe Haven
summary: (Bloomberg) -- US insurance-related stocks rallied Tuesday, pushing an industry gauge to a record, as artificial intelligence concerns drove traders toward defensive parts of the market.
